correctness.rationale: The open-neighborhood condition for this cubic graph is exactly the local alternative of one versus three distinct neighbor colors. Consecutive-column states encode all proper and local parity constraints, including the cyclic seam. All four color-permutation representative states have a unique successor; their displayed cycles exhaust the 84 four-color states and have only even lengths 2,4,6, yielding the exact named-palette count and odd obstruction. Explicit closed walks of lengths 4,5,7 with a shared two-column base state concatenate to five-color every odd circumference at least five. The triangular prism has graph-square K6; even prisms are bipartite cubic graphs. Exact trace counts enumerate all five-palette cyclic assignments. verify.py reproduces the finite classifications and independent direct vertex searches.

value.rationale: This is a complete infinite-family exact determination for the basic cubic Cartesian prism graph, with a sharp jump at odd circumference. The obstruction is structural: a four-symbol local automaton collapses to even-period cycles of lengths 2,4,6, giving all four-palette colorings and ruling out three-color possibilities. Explicit cyclic gluing establishes all odd sizes; a uniform 260-state exact trace counts every optimal odd coloring. This supplies motivated new structure and enumeration, not a minor bound increment or an arbitrary finite example.
